source.display_title: 05/13/2026 - Jorge Vargas x Farooq Bey  — Follow Up

prospect.name: Jorge Vargas
prospect.occupation: Mechanical engineer — 'I'm a professional, I'm a 40 years old, so I'm already settled at work'
prospect.family_status: Married to Carlin; four children aged 4 to 12, all in sports. Buying decision is explicitly joint — 'anything we do, we always do together'.
prospect.training_background: Long-time lifter with a home gym; he and his wife train together every day from 4am to 6am, split routine (back and triceps, chest and triceps, legs) plus cardio, and he will also train two hours at a commercial gym. Practises 16:8 intermittent fasting as a couple. Tried Trevor's Instagram kettlebell workouts for about a week using kettlebells at his work gym; owns none at home.
prospect.medical: None disclosed. When injuries came up inside the pillar-one pitch he said 'We don't have any injuries or anything like that.' No health-condition question was asked at any point in discovery.

signals: Already fit and explicitly says so — 'I'm not overweight. Neither one of us is overweight. So, and we're pretty, you know, fit'
Professionally settled mechanical engineer, 40, home gym, trains daily at 4am; the ask is refinement and time-efficiency, not rescue
Rates himself 5/10 purely against his own ceiling — 'I think you can always get better'
Wants a shorter, more effective stimulus rather than more work: 'we're trying to short that time where maybe it's not spent so much time doing long workouts'

goals.text: Get leaner and stronger as a couple
Get the same or better results in far less training time — currently two hours a day from 4am
Everyday mobility that gym machines and dumbbells do not give — 'go for a bike ride' and 'go up two flights of steps and not be huffing and puffing'
Stay around and healthy for four kids aged 4 to 12 — 'we want to make sure that we're going to be around for a long time'
Get his wife Carlin a targeted programme for the areas she wants to change, particularly her midsection
Eventually teach kettlebell training to their children

pains.text: Training two hours a day at 4am and it eats the day; with four kids in sports the time cost is the binding constraint
Gym work is machines and dumbbells that 'really don't help you on the everyday mobility'
Wife has been struggling with her stomach area and not seeing results from their current app-based workouts
Self-directed — no external programming, no one targeting his wife's specific areas: 'I want somebody that can know what are the areas that she wants to target'

evidence: All three pillars were delivered but the price was never stated — the prospect had to ask for it: 'can we schedule another call so we can speak more about the pricing and everything?'
High stated intent at the point of ending: 'as you can see, we're really interested and we really want to do it.'
Hard stop from the prospect's side, not a brush-off: 'I had to leave in two minutes because I had to bring one of my sons to basketball.'
Counter-evidence on the follow-up itself: no second call was actually booked. The rep offered 'later this evening or tomorrow' and the prospect deferred to check with his wife.

Counter-evidence: the rep's WhatsApp/iMessage to the prospect failed to deliver, and the prospect noted he blocks unknown numbers — 'Oh, it said it didn't deliver.' The follow-up now depends on the prospect texting a +44 number he nearly treated as spam.
outcome.next_step: Unscheduled. Prospect to check his wife's calendar and message the rep on his UK mobile (+44) or via his wife's WhatsApp. No date, no time, no calendar invite, no link.

notable.note: A high-intent, on-profile prospect who reached the end of a 26-minute call without ever hearing a price, and who then left with no booked follow-up and a delivery-failed text message as the only channel back. Two structural things worth a manager's attention. First, the rep pitched the whole programme as covering two people — 'both of you are going to receive two separate individualized programs', 'You each going to get' Trevor's number — without ever saying whether that is one enrolment or two, or what it costs; the prospect is now waiting for a price on an arrangement whose scope was never defined. Second, discovery was almost entirely absent on facts: no height, no weight, no work question, no health-condition question, no sleep, no energy, no diet, no past-attempts sequence, and no consequence frame at all. The rep spent his effort almost entirely on the deep-why question, asked four different ways, which the prospect deflected each time back to time-efficiency.

quality.notes: Severe and sustained inversion. Long passages of the rep's scripted pillar delivery appear under 'Jorge Vargas' (most of the 00:22:00 accountability block, the 00:19:29 nutrition block) and the prospect's answers appear under 'Farooq Bey (Primal Instinct)'. Several exchanges also merge two turns into one line. Roles were resolved from content only. Do not use this file for anything line-attributed. Additionally, around 00:22:30 to 00:23:10 a family interruption (the prospect's daughter) is interleaved into the transcript with no speaker separation.
